name: Classic Bass
description: Two saws and a square an octave apart into a closed ladder that the filter contour snaps open at each note: the bass the instrument is known for.

name: Fifth Bass
description: Two saws with the third a fifth up, through a half-open ladder: a bass that plays power chords.

name: Funk Bass
description: A saw and a square with the emphasis up, the contour snapping the filter and falling back fast: a quacking funk bass.

name: Glide Bass
description: Two saws and a square, gliding where the notes touch, the filter struck only on the first: a sliding bass.

name: Growl Bass
description: Three saws spread wide at 16 feet, beating fast, under a ladder with some emphasis: a growling bass.

name: Octave Bass
description: Saws at 32 and 16 feet with a square at 8, each a little apart, the ladder lifted by the contour: a full bass that spans three octaves.

name: Overdriven Bass
description: All three saws at full into the mixer's soft limit, overdriving the ladder: a thick, gritty bass.

name: Picked Bass
description: A saw and a burst of white noise in the strike, the contour quick: a bass with a pick's click.

name: Pluck Bass
description: A short, round pluck: the filter and the loudness both fall to nothing within a fifth of a second, and a key let go is cut at once.

name: Reed Bass
description: A narrow and a wide pulse at 16 feet beating slowly, the ladder half open: a buzzing, reedy bass.

name: Round Bass
description: Three saws, the third an octave down, under a low ladder with the contour lifting each note a little: a warm, round bass that holds.

name: Rubber Bass
description: A narrow pulse and a saw with the emphasis up, the contour bouncing the corner at each note: an elastic bass.

name: Shark Bass
description: The shark-tooth wave on the first two oscillators, a saw under them, the ladder half open: a buzzy, nasal bass.

name: Soft Bass
description: Triangle and saw under a dark ladder with a slower contour: a soft bass for ballads.

name: Square Bass
description: Squares at 16 and 32 feet through a half-shut ladder: a hollow, woody bass.

name: Squelch Bass
description: One saw into the ladder with its emphasis high: each note's contour sweeps the singing corner down through it.

name: Sub Bass
description: Triangles at 8 and 4 feet, played low, through a ladder that rounds them: a deep, clean sub.

name: Thump Bass
description: A square and a triangle under a nearly closed ladder, the contour flicking it once: a short, dark thump.

name: Tight Acid Bass
description: One square into the ladder with high emphasis, gliding where the notes touch: an acid line that whistles.

name: Touch Bass
description: Two saws and a square with velocity on, so a hard note is loud and a soft one falls back: a bass that follows the hands.

name: Trill Bass
description: Oscillator 3's slow square, through the wheel, trills the pitch of two saws a little: a bass that warbles.

name: Wide Pulse Bass
description: Two wide pulses at 16 and 32 feet, the ladder opened by the contour: a nasal, reedy bass.

name: Wobble
description: Oscillator 3 at the LO range moving the cutoff through the wheel, slowly, under two saws an octave down.

name: Zap Bass
description: The contour at full amount over a closed ladder, decaying fast with high emphasis: a bass that zaps at each note.

name: Brass Stab
description: Three saws whose filter opens and shuts within a beat: a short, punchy horn hit.

name: Brass Swell
description: Saws behind a filter that opens slowly with each note and settles a little shut: a horn section's breath.

name: Bright Brass
description: Three saws whose ladder opens fast and settles bright, a quick swell: a solo trumpet's bite.

name: Poly Brass
description: Five voices, each two saws and a third an octave down, swelling into each chord: a brass section, which the hardware cannot play.

name: Solo Horn
description: A saw and a triangle under a ladder that swells part way open: a mellow, rounded horn.

name: Beating Drone
description: Three saws at 32, 16 and 16 feet a little apart, slowly beating under a low, singing ladder: a dark, uneasy drone.

name: Laser
description: The contour, with the third oscillator's reverse saw at LO swinging the pitch hard through the wheel: a ray gun firing.

name: Noise Riser
description: White noise and a saw whose ladder opens over seconds, the emphasis up: a build-up for a drop.

name: Random Bleeps
description: Noise as the modulation source, through the wheel to the pitch and the ladder: a computer chattering.

name: Siren
description: The third oscillator's triangle at LO, slow, swinging two squares' pitch through the wheel: a wailing siren.

name: Wind
description: Pink noise through a singing ladder, the third oscillator's slow triangle sweeping it through the wheel: gusting wind.

name: Clav
description: A narrow pulse and a square with the emphasis up, struck and snapped shut: a clav for funk.

name: Poly Keys
description: Six voices of triangle and square struck and fading, the ladder closing over them: a soft electric piano.

name: Poly Organ
description: Six voices of squares at 8 and 4 feet and a triangle at 2, with no contour: an organ that starts and stops with the keys.

name: Brass Lead
description: Saws whose filter swells in at each note, following the keys: a lead that speaks like a trumpet.

name: Chime Lead
description: A saw with triangles two and three octaves up, the ladder open: a lead with a chime over it.

name: Cross Mod Lead
description: Oscillator 3 an octave and a fifth up and silent, swinging the others' pitch at audio rate: a bright, glassy lead.

name: Fat Lead
description: Three saws a few cents apart, the filter following the keyboard, with a short glide between legato notes.

name: Fifth Lead
description: Saws a fifth apart, the third an octave down: a lead that plays in parallel fifths.

name: Flute Lead
description: A triangle with pink noise under it, a soft swell and the third oscillator's slow vibrato on the wheel: a breathy flute.

name: Low Mono Lead
description: Three saws, one an octave down, under a warm ladder with emphasis: a round lead for low melodies.

name: Metal Growl
description: Oscillator 3 a fifth above, at audio rate, swinging the other two's pitch through the wheel: an inharmonic, clangorous growl with no sync.

name: Noise Lead
description: A saw with a lot of white noise through a ladder that sings a little: an airy, breathy lead.

name: Octave Lead
description: Saws an octave apart and a square two octaves up: a bright, organ-tinged lead.

name: Pulse Lead
description: Two narrow pulses a few cents apart, the ladder open: a thin, nasal lead.

name: Sharp Lead
description: Two shark-tooth waves and a narrow pulse, the ladder wide: a lead with a hard, cutting edge.

name: Singing Ladder
description: No oscillators: the ladder at full emphasis sings a sine at its corner, a breath of pink noise starting it, and the keyboard plays the corner an octave an octave.

name: Slow Glide Lead
description: Two saws and a triangle with a long glide, so every interval slides: a lead for slow, expressive lines.

name: Snarl Lead
description: Oscillator 3 an octave down, on the keyboard and silent, shaking the ladder's corner at audio rate through the wheel: a lead with a snarl in it.

name: Soaring Lead
description: Three saws, one an octave up, the ladder open and following the keys, a slow glide: a lead that soars over a band.

name: Square Lead
description: Two squares an octave apart, the ladder half open: a hollow, clarinet-like lead.

name: Sync-Free Scream
description: Three saws hard into the mixer and the ladder near singing, the contour sweeping it: a screaming, overdriven lead.

name: Third Lead
description: Saws a major third apart, the third oscillator an octave down: a lead that sounds a chord on every note.

name: Trill Lead
description: Oscillator 3's square, off the keyboard, through the wheel: each held note trills a step up and back.

name: Vibrato Lead
description: A square and a saw, oscillator 3 off the keyboard at the LO range as a slow triangle: the wheel brings in vibrato.

name: Wah Lead
description: Two saws through a resonant ladder that the contour throws open and lets fall at each note: a lead that says wah.

name: Whistle Lead
description: A triangle alone, rounded further by the ladder, gliding: a pure, whistled line.

name: Wide Detune Lead
description: Three saws spread a quarter tone, beating fast, a short glide: a thick, chorused lead.

name: Dark Poly Pad
description: Six voices of triangles and saws under a low ladder, slow in and out: a dark bed for chords.

name: Drift Pad
description: Six voices of saws with the drift up, each voice wandering in pitch: a pad that breathes like old circuits.

name: Poly Pad
description: Six voices, each three saws through its own ladder, slow to swell and slow to let go: chords, which the hardware cannot play.

name: Poly Strings
description: Six voices of saws a little apart, slow to bow in and out, the ladder fairly open: a string section, which the hardware cannot play.

name: Wheel Sweep Pad
description: Six voices whose ladders the third oscillator's slow triangle sweeps through the wheel: a pad that rises and falls.

name: Ladder Tom
description: The singing ladder with a breath of noise, the contour falling a little: a tuned tom that follows the keys, singing the key played.

name: Noise Hat
description: White noise with the ladder wide open and the emphasis up, so only its top comes through, in a short tick.

name: Noise Snare
description: White noise alone through a half-open ladder, the loudness falling to nothing in a tenth of a second.

name: Pizzicato
description: A triangle and a saw, a soft strike that falls away fast: a plucked string.

name: Pluck Lead
description: Two saws whose ladder is snapped open and falls back to nothing within a beat: a bright, plucked line.

name: Poly Pluck
description: Six voices of saw and square, each struck and ringing a moment: plucked chords and arpeggios.

name: Resonant Pluck
description: One saw with high emphasis, the contour sweeping the corner down: a chirping pluck.

name: Deep Sequence
description: Saws at 16 and 32 feet, the ladder low and flicked: a dark, rolling sequence under a track.

name: Glide Sequence
description: A square with high emphasis and a fast glide, the contour clicking at each step: a sliding, squelchy sequence.

name: Ladder Sequence
description: A saw and a square, the contour clicking the resonant ladder at each step: tight, squelching sixteenths.

name: Pulse Sequence
description: Two narrow pulses, short and bright: sixteenths that tick along.
